c0.f0: Based on the famous ISP® Decimator™* noise gate pedal. Its Linearized Time Vector Processing™ gives a more linear release response to the downward expander.

c1.f0: Based on the legendary Ross™ Compressor — the originator of the guitar compression effect, with a natural and mellow compression.
c1.f1: Based on the Keeley® C4 4-knob compressor*. A recording studio-level compressor that keeps your high frequencies bright.
c1.f2: Based on the famous Xotic® EP Booster* pedal. Provides +20dB of clean lift with strong lows and bright highs.
c1.f3: Based on the legendary MXR® M133 Micro Amp pedal. Up to 20dB of gain that elevates your amp sound without changing its character.
c1.f4: Based on the Xotic® BB Preamp* overdrive pedal. Equally good for thick creamy overdrive or for pushing an already driven clean front end.
c1.f5: A wide-range envelope filter (touch wah) for guitar and bass that responds to playing intensity.
c1.f6: A variable auto-wah effect for both guitars and basses. Set the rate to make the pedal work regularly.
c1.f9: Combines a slightly detuned signal with the original to create a chorus-like tone.

c2.f0: Based on the legendary Ibanez® TS-808 Tube Screamer®* overdrive. A warm, delicate overdrive used since 1979 by countless guitarists.
c2.f1: Asymmetric overdrive modeled after a 1970s classic. The positive and negative halves of the waveform are not distorted equally, so the sound stays close to the original.
c2.f2: A unique asymmetric overdrive that adds a warm, pleasant character to the traditional guitar timbre.
c2.f3: Based on a classic orange three-knob distortion effector that captures the timbre characteristics of the 70s and 80s.
c2.f4: Based on the legendary MXR® M104 Distortion+*. A Germanium-powered soft-clipping distortion in the Randy Rhoads tradition.
c2.f5: Based on the MI Audio® Crunch Box®* distortion pedal. Balanced response across every frequency band and faithful fingertip dynamics, even at high gain.
c2.f6: Based on the legendary ProCo™ The Rat* distortion (early LM308 version). A wide Filter knob delivers bright, compact, full-bodied sound.
c2.f7: Based on the legendary Dallas-Arbiter® Fuzz Face®*. Heavy and sharp fuzz that has influenced countless famous musicians since 1966.
c2.f8: Based on the legendary Dallas-Arbiter® Fuzz Face®*. Heavy and sharp fuzz that has influenced countless famous musicians since 1966.
c2.f9: An overdrive designed specifically for bass. Combines the original bass sound with a unique overdrive for a very good distortion while keeping the bass dynamic tone.

c4.f0: Based on the Fender® Tweed Deluxe*. From clean to wild overdrive, this amp has been a totem in every style for more than 60 years.
c4.f1: Based on the Fender® '59 Bassman®*. Originally designed for bass, it became the most classic guitar speaker. As clear as water, with vacuum-tube beauty.
c4.f2: Based on the Fender® '65 Twin Reverb®*. With a Stratocaster* the classic sound can be easily restored for country jazz and rock.
c4.f3: Based on the VOX® AC30HW* (normal channel). The symbolic clear sound and warm overdrive that drove the British Invasion and still powers bands like Radiohead and Oasis.
c4.f4: Based on the legendary Jazz Chorus solid-state combo. The first musical-instrument amp with a chorus effect, famous for pure sound and stereo chorus.
c4.f5: Based on the Matchless™ Chieftain 212 combo* (clean tone). Crisp graininess and perfect dynamic feedback make playing easy.
c4.f6: Based on the Mesa/Boogie® Lone Star™* (CH1). Engaging, lively timbre with a compressed and balanced mid frequency and bell-like highs.
c4.f7: Based on the Marshall® JTM45* (normal channel). The 1962 amp that laid the foundation for rock music — the Plexi.
c4.f8: Based on the Marshall® JMP50* (Jump connection). More powerful than the JTM45* by way of its rectifier tube, with a fuller Plexi sound.
c4.f9: Based on the Marshall® JCM800*. In 1981 it quickly became the rock and metal sound of the 80s with its excellent high-gain tone.
c4.f10: Based on the Fender® '59 Bassman®* Bright CH. The most classic guitar speaker, originally designed for bass. Clear as water, vacuum-tube beauty.
c4.f11: Based on the VOX® AC30HW* (Top Boost channel). The British Invasion tone with Cool and Hot sound characters.
c4.f12: Based on the Supro® Dual-Tone 1624T* (CH1+2, dirty tone). The volume knob past noon evolves from fat compressed clean tone into an immediately recognizable grind.
c4.f13: Based on the Soldano® SLO100* (crunch channel).
c4.f14: Based on the Dr. Z® Maz 38 Sr.* combo (Hi Input). Varied sound and wide dynamic range — equally suited to British and American tones.
c4.f15: Based on the Bad Cat® Hot Cat 30* (overdrive channel). The world's first Class A guitar amp, combining British and American styles with rich harmonics and headroom.
c4.f16: Based on the Orange® Rockerverb 100™* (Dirty channel). Unique sound that goes from warm clean to heavy.
c4.f17: Based on the Diezel® VH4* CH3. Born in 1990s Germany, its timbre and multifunction attracted countless masters. Unique modern high gain.
c4.f18: Based on the Diezel® VH4* CH4. Born in 1990s Germany, its timbre and multifunction attracted countless masters. Unique modern high gain.
c4.f19: ENGL® Savage 120* — embodies ENGL's legacy of metal machines with truly punishing tones, clear dynamics, and tremendous sonic variety across 4 channels and two discrete EQs.
c4.f20: Based on the Peavey® 5150® (LEAD channel). Eddie Van Halen's metallic sound, named after the album title.
c4.f21: Based on the Soldano® SLO100* (overdrive channel). Eddie Van Halen's Brown Sound and Steve Vai's classic Passion & Warfare album were recorded through it.
c4.f22: Based on the Mesa/Boogie® Dual Rectifier* (CH3, Vintage mode). Rectifier-series distortion is warm and very wide — thicker and more solid than Mark.
c4.f23: Based on the Mesa/Boogie® Dual Rectifier* (CH3, Modern mode). Rectifier-series distortion is warm and very wide — thicker and more solid than Mark.
c4.f24: Based on the ENGL® Powerball II E645/2* (CH4). Extremely compact low frequency, lots of gain and precise dynamic response for modern rock and metal.
c4.f25: Based on the famous Brown Eye UK-style boutique amp head (HBE channel).
c4.f26: The Bogner® XTC* red channel is known for its fiery high-gain distortion and main timbre.
c4.f27: Based on the Ampeg® SVT* bass amp. Launched in 1969, it has always been the most mainstream bass speaker with a strong sound-shaping ability.
c4.f28: Based on the vintage VOX®* AC-100* bass amp. In 1963, the Beatles needed more volume than a club's shouting — the AC-100* was the answer. 100W, 4x12, the bass voice of the 1960s.
c4.f29: Based on the Mesa/Boogie® Bass 400* amp. The early-bass-amp sound heard on many classic albums.
c4.f30: Based on the AER® Colourizer 2* acoustic preamp. Designed in Germany for acoustic guitar sound reinforcement, it brings richer dynamics and three-dimensional sound.
c4.f31: Based on the AER® Colourizer 2* acoustic preamp. Designed in Germany for acoustic guitar sound reinforcement, it brings richer dynamics and three-dimensional sound.

c5.f10: Vintage Marshall® 4x12" cabinet with Celestion® Greenback®* speakers.

c6.f0: Equalizer designed for guitars with five frequency bands.
c6.f1: Equalizer designed for guitars with five frequency bands.
c6.f2: Equalizer designed for basses with five frequency bands.
c6.f3: Equalizer designed for basses with five frequency bands.
c6.f4: Based on the 5-band EQ module on Mesa/Boogie®* amps — easily realizes the classic Boogie V-shaped sound.

c7.f0: Based on the legendary Arion® SCH-1* stereo chorus pedal. Used by Eric Clapton and Michael Landau to create the wonderful atmosphere of the 80s.
c7.f1: Based on a famous ensemble chorus unit tuned for bassists.
c7.f2: Classic flanger effect, producing rich and natural flanger tone.
c7.f3: A flanger with negative feedback, producing an underwater-style sound.
c7.f4: Based on the legendary MXR® M101 Phase 90*. The phaser behind Eddie Van Halen's Eruption tone.
c7.f5: Based on the Voodoo Lab® Micro Vibe*. The same design as the original 1968 Uni-Vibe*, used extensively by Hendrix and Stevie Ray Vaughan.
c7.f6: Based on a BBD-based blue vibrato pedal, producing natural analog vibrato sound.
c7.f7: A classic vibrato effect with wide adjustable range.

c8.f1: Produces warm delay sound with analog feel.
c8.f2: Simulates the classic slapback echo effect.
c8.f3: This analog delay pedal was sold from 1981 to 1984 and is still sought after for its warm natural sound. The original only produced 20-300 ms of delay.
c8.f6: Produces a special delay effect with reversed feedback.
c8.f7: Produces a delay effect with ring-modulated repeats.
c8.f8: Produces a delay effect with sweeping-filter-modulated repeats.
c8.f9: A ping-pong delay producing stereo feedback bounces back and forth between left and right channels.

c9.f0: An airy reverb effect with natural decays.
c9.f1: Simulates the spaciousness of a room.
c9.f2: Simulates the spaciousness of a performance hall.
c9.f3: Simulates the spaciousness of a church.
c9.f4: Simulates the sound character produced by a large plate reverberator.
c9.f5: Simulates the sound character produced by a vintage small plate reverberator.
c9.f6: Simulates the sound character produced by a vintage spring reverberator.
c9.f7: Special-tuned reverb effect with lush, bright decays.
c9.f8: Special-tuned reverb effect with huge, deep decays.
c9.f9: Produces a modulated reverb effect that is lush and sweet.
